minSize.reason: no parameter snapshot at or before the window

totalDrepPowerAda.definition: Summed voting power (lovelace) over every non-special DRep snapshot row for the epoch.

poweredDrepCount.definition: Non-special DRep snapshot rows with voting power above zero this epoch.

recentlyVotingDrepCount.definition: DReps that voted at least once in the last 12 epochs, superseded votes included. Votes without a block time are not counted.

silentPoweredDrepCount.definition: DReps holding delegated power in the epoch snapshot with no vote in the last 12 epochs, superseded votes included. NULL until the repair pass has read the epoch.

abstainPowerAda.definition: Voting power (lovelace) delegated to the predefined always-abstain option this epoch.

ancPowerAda.definition: Voting power (lovelace) delegated to the predefined no-confidence option this epoch.

delegatorTotal.definition: Sum of live-observed delegator counts over the epoch snapshot rows, set only when every row carries an observation, never a partial sum.

abstainDelegators.definition: Live-observed delegator count of the always-abstain option, recorded from the epoch stamping began.

ancDelegators.definition: Live-observed delegator count of the no-confidence option, recorded from the epoch stamping began.

gini.definition: Gini coefficient of voting power across snapshot rows with power above zero, excluding the predefined options.

top10SharePct.definition: Share of the epoch total held by the ten largest non-special DReps, computed from the raw power distribution.

minCoalition50.definition: Fewest DReps whose combined voting power reaches 50% of the epoch total, based on delegated power, not actual coordination.

minCoalition67.definition: Fewest DReps whose combined voting power reaches 67% of the epoch total, based on delegated power, not actual coordination.

votesCast.definition: DRep votes cast during the epoch, later-superseded votes included. Votes without a block time are not counted.
